args.content:
Hawaii Vacation Packing List
June 10-20, 2024

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (multiple sets)
- Sunscreen (high SPF, reef-safe)
- Sunglasses
- Sun hat/cap
- Beach towel
- Flip flops/sandals
- Water shoes (for snorkeling)

Clothing:
- Casual outfits (lightweight, breathable)
- Light jacket or sweater (for cooler evenings)
- Sleepwear
- Undergarments
- Socks
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Dressier outfit (for luau on June 16)

Activity-Specific Gear:
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike on June 13)
- Snorkeling equipment (mask, snorkel - though can be rented)
- Waterproof phone case/dry bag
- Camera
- Binoculars

Personal Items:
- Toiletries
- Medications
- First aid kit
- Insect repellent
- Travel documents (ID, passport if needed, hotel confirmations)
- Credit cards and cash
- Travel adapter (if needed)
- Reusable water bottle

Electronics:
- Phone and charger
- Camera and charger
- Portable power bank
- Headphones

Miscellaneous:
- Books/magazines for beach reading
- Travel pillow
- Snacks for travel days
- Small backpack/day bag
